run_librispeech_prep: run the script to download LibriSpeech data and prepare fbank features and TSV manifests
build_librispeech_dataset: build a LibriSpeech dataset with extracted fbank features, vocab, and config for speech-to-text training
create_fbank_features: create log mel filter bank features from LibriSpeech audio WAV files and pack them into a ZIP archive
generate_tsv_manifests: generate TSV manifest files for each LibriSpeech split with audio paths, frame counts, and text
generate_speech_vocab: generate a SentencePiece vocabulary model from LibriSpeech training text with a specified vocab size
